messages:
maria: starting final handoff for tonight's change window (EU midnight). quick checklist: pins, quotas, canary rules, rollback thresholds, post-launch channel. please confirm.
kevin: confirmed pins: service-api v2.14.3 -> pinned to canary pool, db-migration off for window. token-quota bump request submitted to finance but we have contingency.
juan: FYI: token-bank is at 65% committed. i'm enabling soft-throttle at 80% and hard at 95% for embeddings jobs in the window.
alexa: created #launch-175777 for live ops and post-launch notes. will add owners and runbook links.
maria: deploy-bot, kick off canary at 23:00 UTC and follow the traffic plan: 5% for 15m, if stable -> 25% for 20m, then 50% for 10m, then 100% after signoff. abort/rollback on either error-rate +1.5pp or p95 latency +200ms.
deploy-bot: Canary started: release=v2.14.3 canary_id=canary-1757 start_ts=1757771400 target_traffic=5% logs_url=https://internal/reports/canary-1757
kevin: monitoring dashboards open. SLOs to watch: request_error_rate, p95_latency, token_usage. set alert thresholds to the guardrails above.
juan: small note — if token-hard-throttle triggers, we should automatically reduce non-prod traffic and pause background emb jobs. who owns that rollback automation?
maria: ops-sre owns throttle automation. kevin, can you validate the throttle playbook now?
kevin: validated. throttle rules are in place:
```
# throttle rule snippet
if token_usage >= 95%:
  - set rate_limit non-prod=10r/s
  - pause job_queue=embeddings-worker
  - notify @oncall-bot
```
alexa: oncall-bot, please create an incident channel if any alert fires in the next 40m and page the oncall rotation.
oncall-bot: Acknowledged. Will create #incident-175777 if any alert severity >= P2 is raised. Pager rotation: @juan then @maria.
maria: rollback command ready (manual):
```
deploy rollback --service service-api --to-tag v2.14.2 --reason "canary-failure" --no-confirm
```
maria: automated rollback triggers also configured: error_rate_increase >= 1.5pp over baseline OR p95_latency_increase >= 200ms for 10m window -> auto-rollback.
kevin: small safety: add a second-check window of 2 minutes before auto-rollback to reduce flapping.
maria: added. also adding a pin exemption: if we need to hotfix we can pin traffic back to legacy at any time with `traffic pin legacy 100%`.
juan: logs showing a slight spike in 404s at minute 6 of canary (0.3% -> 0.8%). keeping eyes on it.
kevin: that's within tolerance but i'll keep it on the dashboard; if it crosses 1.5% raise flag.
alexa: rolling notes to #launch-175777. tagging infra, support, docs for release notes publish when we hit 50%.
maria: decision point at 23:20 UTC: if canary is stable we proceed to 25%. if not, we rollback. everyone ack?
kevin: ack
juan: ack
alexa: ack
maria: proceeding to ramp -> instructing deploy-bot to set target to 25% now.
deploy-bot: Traffic update: canary-1757 target_traffic now 25% at 1757771600
kevin: metrics look good at 25% for first 10m. no error spikes. p95 +30ms only.
juan: token consumption trending +12% but within planned burn.
maria: moving to 50% after 20m if green. post-launch checklist: publish release notes, verify key customer endpoints, start 2h watch.
alexa: publishing release notes draft now. will ping growth for announcement hold.
kevin: thumbs on dashboards. currently error_rate delta +0.2pp, p95 delta +40ms.
maria: ok go to 50% then hold for signoff.
kevin: setting deploy-bot to 50%.
deploy-bot: Traffic update: canary-1757 target_traffic now 50% at 1757771800
juan: seeing a small uptick in ingestion queue; will scale ingestion-workers by +1 to compensate.
maria: scaling ok. final go/no-go in 10m. if anything crosses thresholds we rollback. otherwise we continue to full cutover and close change window.
alexa: creating postmortem template in #launch-175777 in case we need it.
maria: thanks team. standing by on pager.
